children: Palm oil falls amid cautious sentiment, AmInvestment Bank says in a note. Market direction will depend on movements in Dalian Commodity Exchange palm oil, Chicago Board of Trade soybean oil and crude oil prices, it says. Overall, prices remain vulnerable to further selling pressure, although a rebound could emerge near key support for CPO at 4,608 ringgit a ton, it adds. AmInvestment Bank pegs the resistance level at 4,675 ringgit-4,680 ringgit a ton. The Bursa Malaysia Derivatives contract for December delivery is down 42 ringgit at 4,595 ringgit a ton. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
